description: Add comprehensive latency audit tests that prove the optimizations work and expose the specific bottleneck sources. Create tests for all endpoints, API routes, pipelines, and workflows that measure and assert latency characteristics.
steps: STEP 1 - Create apps/backend/tests/test_latency_audit.py with tests that verify: (a) retrieve_context and load_conversation_history can run in parallel (mock both, assert they are called concurrently via timing or asyncio.gather verification), (b) rate_limit check uses pipeline (mock redis pipeline), (c) middleware chain is single-pass (measure middleware overhead).

STEP 2 - Create apps/backend/tests/test_endpoints_audit.py that tests ALL API route registrations: import the app, enumerate all routes, verify each route handler is accessible (GET returns non-500, POST with valid body returns non-500). This catches deployment issues like missing dependencies or import errors.

STEP 3 - Create apps/backend/tests/test_pipeline_audit.py that tests the full chat pipeline end-to-end with mocked external services (Azure Search, Sarvam, Cloudflare AI, Redis, MongoDB). Verify the pipeline completes in under 100ms with mocked services (proving no unnecessary sequential waits).

STEP 4 - Create apps/edge/tests/latency-audit.test.ts that tests: (a) rate limit adds X-Rate-Limited-By header, (b) proxy request includes Connection: keep-alive, (c) JWT verification is fast (no external calls for valid tokens).

STEP 5 - Create apps/frontend/src/__tests__/deployment-audit.test.js that verifies: (a) all lucide-react imports resolve without errors (import each icon used in the codebase), (b) critical pages can render without crashes (BrowserPage, TestimonialsFooter).
acceptance_criteria: apps/backend/tests/test_endpoints_audit.py passes and covers all registered routes
apps/backend/tests/test_pipeline_audit.py proves chat pipeline completes in <100ms with mocked services
apps/frontend deployment audit test passes with vitest
All tests expose real latency sources and would catch regressions
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/-kalukaliya/apps/backend && APP_ENV=test JWT_SECRET=test-secret-at-least-32-characters-long-for-ci python -m pytest tests/test_latency_audit.py tests/test_endpoints_audit.py tests/test_pipeline_audit.py -v
